caption_en:
9 Jewish communities. Spot the pattern. 🙃

Jews are white. Obviously. 🙃

Yemenite white. Ethiopian white. Moroccan white. Iraqi white. Persian white. Kurdish white. Bukharan white. Indian (Bene Israel) white. And Ashkenazi: actually white.

The facts behind the joke:
🇮🇱 About half of Israel's Jews are Mizrahi or Sephardi: 48%, against 45% Ashkenazi (Pew Research Center, "Israel's Religiously Divided Society", 2016).
🇪🇹 177,600 Israelis are of Ethiopian origin (Israel Central Bureau of Statistics, 2024 data, published November 2025).
🗺️ Their families came home from North Africa, the Middle East, Asia and Europe: Yemen, Ethiopia, Morocco, Iraq, Iran, Kurdistan, Bukhara, India, Poland and many more.

Jews aren't a skin color. We're a people.

Illustrations: drawn for this reel, not real people. AI-assisted.

Send this to someone who still thinks Jews are one color.

יהודים הם לבנים. ברור. 🙃
העובדות: כמחצית מיהודי ישראל הם מזרחים או ספרדים, 48% לעומת 45% אשכנזים (Pew, 2016). 177,600 ישראלים ממוצא אתיופי (הלמ"ס, נתוני 2024).
יהודים הם לא צבע עור. אנחנו עם.
